characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Legendarium)
characters.summary: Legolas is an Elven prince from Mirkwood who fights primarily as a master archer and scout, possessing superhuman Elven agility, endurance, and senses.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to standard physical harm if struck

sources.supports: Basic summary, abilities, and weapons of Legolas

feats.claim: Shot down a Nazgûl's fell beast from the sky at night with a great bow.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring / The Two Towers

notableResults.note: Defeated numerous orcs during the War of the Ring.

campaignTags.claim: Elven stealth and quiet movement in forests

unknowns: Exact number of kills in the Battle of Helm's Deep differs slightly between book and film versions.

characters.summary: Lúthien is an Elf-maiden of immense power, utilizing sleep-inducing magic, songs of enchantment, and disguise to overcome formidable adversaries.
weaknesses: Mortal physical body despite divine parentage
mobility: Standard Elven mobility, assisted by magic
limitations: Spellcasting requires immense concentration and song

sources.supports: Lúthien's parentage, magic, and encounters in The Silmarillion

feats.claim: Put Morgoth and his court into a deep magical slumber using her song and spellwork.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion - Of Beren and Lúthien

notableResults.note: Put Morgoth to sleep to steal a Silmaril.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses potent Elven and Maia-descended magic
Uses spells and songs of overwhelming power

unknowns: The exact limits of her magic against unembodied spirits are not fully detailed.

characters.summary: Mablung of the Heavy Hand is a renowned Elven captain of Doriath, fighting with sword and shield alongside King Thingol.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to superior numbers of armed foes
limitations: Mortal physical limitations common to Sindar Elves

sources.supports: Mablung's role as captain of Doriath and combat feats

feats.claim: Fought courageously in the defense of Doriath and guarded the Nauglafír.

notableResults.note: Overpowered while defending the treasury of Menegroth.

unknowns: Exact circumstances of his final defeat are sparse in remaining texts.

characters.summary: Maedhros the Tall was a Noldorin prince and master swordsman, known for fighting with a blade even after losing his right hand.
weaknesses: Missing right hand (until he learned to fight left-handed)
mobility: Standard Elven movement and horseback riding
limitations: Hampered initially by the loss of his right hand

sources.supports: Maedhros history, loss of hand, and martial prowess

feats.claim: Survived hanging from Thangorodrim by his wrist for years before rescue.

notableResults.note: Led numerous successful campaigns during the early Siege of Angband.

unknowns: Full extent of his combat capability after losing his hand is legendary rather than systematically measured.

characters.summary: Maglor is a Noldorin prince, warrior, and renowned minstrel, wielding a sword and the power of song in battle.
weaknesses: Bound by the tragic Oath of Fëanor
limitations: Bound to the fate of the Silmarils

sources.supports: Maglor's background as a warrior and singer

feats.claim: Fought in the major wars of Beleriand alongside his brothers.

unknowns: His ultimate fate after casting a Silmaril into the sea is unrecorded.

characters.summary: Melian is a Maia of immense power who creates impenetrable protective wards (the girdle of Melian) and commands illusions and deep magic.
weaknesses: Weakened and grieved after the death of Thingol and destruction of Doriath
limitations: Bound within a physical raiment in Middle-earth

sources.supports: Melian's identity as a Maia, her girdle, and magical capabilities

feats.claim: Created the Girdle of Melian, a maze of shadow and bewilderment enclosing all of Doriath.

notableResults.note: Drove away Ungoliant with the power of her presence and song.

campaignTags.claim: Is a primordial Maia with vast magical power
Weaves permanent magical barriers and illusions

unknowns: Did not engage in direct physical frontline combat, relying on strategic wards and counsel.

characters.summary: Merry is a Hobbit of the Shire who fights with courage using a Westernesse blade and stealth tactics, famously contributing to the defeat of the Witch-king.
weaknesses: Physically weak compared to Men and Orcs
limitations: Prone to fatigue and physical injury due to small stature

sources.supports: Merry's background, barrow-blade, and role at Pelennor Fields

feats.claim: Stabbed the Witch-king of Angmar in the knee with a Barrow-blade, breaking his spell protection.

notableResults.note: Stabbed him from behind, enabling Eowyn to deliver the killing blow.

campaignTags.claim: Hobbit ability to move silently and unobserved
Wields a Barrow-blade forged with anti-sorcery properties

unknowns: Does not possess supernatural powers independently of his magical blade.

characters.summary: Morgoth is the primordial dark Vala, wielding catastrophic elemental power, dark sorcery, and wielding Grond, the hammer of the underworld.
weaknesses: Permanently diminished in power due to scattering his essence into Arda
Vulnerable to physical wounds (wounded by Fingolfin)
mobility: Ground movement of a massive titan
limitations: Bound permanently to his physical form and crippled in foot and face

sources.supports: Morgoth's origin, weapon Grond, and stature as the primary dark Vala

feats.claim: Slew Fingolfin in single combat after a grueling duel.

notableResults.note: Killed the Elven king, though he sustained permanent limps and facial scars.

campaignTags.claim: Supreme dark Vala with god-like magical and corruptive powers

unknowns: Exact upper limit of his strength after dispersing his power into Matter is unquantifiable.

characters.summary: Melkor Unbound represents the peak primordial state of Melkor before his power was dissipated into Arda and before his physical form became permanently scarred.
weaknesses: Arrogance and inability to understand free will
characters.formDifferences: Represents Melkor at his maximum primordial power prior to spending his essence to dominate matter and before receiving permanent wounds from Fingolfin or Thorondor.

sources.supports: Melkor's original might as the most powerful Ainur before dissipation

unknowns: Direct combat feats in this uninhibited state occurred primarily in cosmic wars against all Valar combined.
